notes.title: Full Release: Known Issues and Bugs
notes.notes:
Ahoy Sailors! We wanted to give you a detailed list of some of the most important known issues & bugs that we have identified ourselves.


 Quality preset sometimes snaps to custom and doesn't want to change back. (Fix by re-opening the settings menu)
 Runtime virtual textures can sometimes show up as a blur when you load in the level. 
 Settings don't update in the actual settings menu. (Settings are updated but isn't reflected in the Menu)
 Flicker when rotating notebook page
 Hand going through bottle when drinking
 “Wait for me” note not playing dialogue
 “A fool” note not playing dialogue
 Cave lighting abruptly changes to bright lighting when entering, there's no gradual change.
 When re-opening the game in the cave, the post processing did not work
 When you leave cave everything remains black 
 Music plays, then it stops  abruptly, then it's quiet for a little bit and then restarts.
 No indication that the game actually saves except for a little sound when clicking on the save button.
 2 Tracks can overlap for a little while when entering the campsite and picking up the note.
 Can crash the boat into certain docking spots.



We aim to keep this list of known issues as up to date as possible, but keep in mind that new issues may pop up. If you come across any issues that are not on this list, please let us know by reporting them on our discord server (link down below).

Thank you for your support and thank you for playing The Archipelago Promise!

notes.title: Full Release Update
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Sailors! 

We are thrilled to announce that The Archipelago Promise, is set to release tomorrow, June 22nd! 
Continue the journey you started in Early Access and get ready to chase down Thomas and Dina, and encounter more dangerous wildlife while exploring the new Caldera Island! 
We will also be introducing a bunch of improvements to the game including the onboarding at the start of the game. 

The Archipelago Promise will release at the following release times:

Asia and Oceania

 New Zealand Standard Time (NZST): 1:00 AM (June 23rd)
 Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST): 11:00 PM
 Japan Standard Time (JST): 10:00 PM
 China Standard Time (CST): 9:00 PM
 Indian Standard Time (IST): 6:30 PM


Europe and Africa

 Moscow Standard Time (MSK): 5:00 PM
 Central European Summer Time (CEST): 3:00 PM
 South Africa Standard Time (SAST): 3:00 PM
 West Africa Time (WAT): 2:00 PM
 British Summer Time (BST): 2:00 PM


The Americas

 Eastern Daylight Time (EDT): 9:00 AM
 Brasília Time (BRT): 10:00 AM
 Mountain Daylight Time (MDT): 7:00 AM
 Pacific Daylight Time (PDT): 6:00 AM
 Alaska Daylight Time (AKDT): 5:00 AM
 Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time (HST): 3:00 AM


As a small student team, witnessing so many players engaging with our creation has been an exciting experience for us all. 
But with this update our year long journey of working on The Archipelago Promise as a student project has sadly come to an end.
We genuinely hope that your time in the Archipelago has been filled with joy, and we aim to amplify that enjoyment with our latest update. 

From development team, thank you for joining us on this adventure, and thank you for playing! 💓 

Survive the voyage and let the unbreakable bond of brothers guide your sail!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hey Sailors,

It's been a while since our Steam Next Fest Demo release, but the day has finally arrived. We are ready to release in Early Access. In this latest version of the Archipelago Promise you'll be able to explore and survive on the Mospeir Island while figuring out what happened to your brother, Thomas. 


With the Early Access comes the opportunity for you to change the course we sail towards. Please reach out to us over discord, or use the feedback form & bug form linked below the let us know what you think.

Feedback Form
Report a Bug



Thank you for your support and thank you for playing The Archipelago Promise!
